title: Brandon Mathis LinkedIn post: We Love Open Source podcast feature
content:
# Had the pleasure to be featured in We Love Open Source podcast series recorded during All Things Open Conference 2025.

## Brandon Mathis’ Post

[](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mathisbrandon?trk=public_post_feed-actor-image)

8mo

Had the pleasure to be featured in [We Love Open Source](https://www.linkedin.com/company/we-love-open-source?trk=public_post-text) podcast series recorded during [All Things Open Conference](https://www.linkedin.com/company/all-things-open?trk=public_post-text) 2025. [Jason Hibbets](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jasonhibbets?trk=public_post-text) and I talked about how AI is quickly changing how I write code, how AI is impacting Open Source maintainers, and what interests (other than AI 😅) I have been exploring lately. Please watch and drop a like! I had a blast recording this one 🚀 [https://lnkd.in/eHY35KRf](https://lnkd.in/eHY35KRf?trk=public_post-text)
